text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S wins the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
back-to-back. The crowd went wild over 
this historic feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy and Tap Dance City devote 
themselves to grueling training in order 
to surpass Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the determination to become an 
"Ordeal" for everyone burning in her 
heart, Symboli Kris S set her sights on 
the Japan Cup.
